More than twenty-two years on this coast

We have watched this place change. And as it changes, we keep asking one question:

How do we want our community to grow?

Our answer has a name: La Tribu. A neighborhood of families around a school.

Eight years ago · Raíces

We have done it before. Together.

Eight families founded Raíces, an alternative kindergarten and primary school inspired by Waldorf education.

We did not only build a school. We built a community.

What we learned with Raíces

Ten of our families bought land together and set part of it aside for the school.

Each family put in $130,000MXN
→
Approximate value today $650,000MXN

5× the first investment

When a community bets on a place together, the value of the land grows with the community.

Why around a school

A school is a magnet.

Families move to be close to a good school. Living next to an alternative school is not a compromise. It is the reason people come.

La Tribu, our secondary school, is already running. For now, in a rented room. Now we are building its home, and a neighborhood around it.

Mexican pesos per m². In the same area of Zapotal, the lowest market price today is $700 per m². In this project: $2,500,000 ÷ 10,000 m² = $250 per m².

2.8× below the lowest market price

The proposal

One hectare. Seven lots.

The whole hectare is divided into seven lots of about 1,300 to 1,560 m². Six of the seven have a sea view. The 2,500 m² school will sit next to them, outside the hectare.

Sea view Illustration only, not to scale.

The heart of the neighborhood

A school that prepares children not only to live in this world, but to care for it.

  • Architecture woven into nature
  • Open spaces and bamboo
  • Learning connected to the land
  • Inspired by projects like Green School Bali

And we build it the way we always have: as a community.

Seven lots. One opportunity.

For families who see it as an investment.

For families who see it as a home.
